summary: Regression check after MONGO_URL fix (Atlas -> local mongo). Cloudflare 524/origin-timeout is GONE. Admin login, user register, user login, /auth/me, /products, and /admin/stats all return HTTP 200 in <1s via public URL. UI verified end-to-end: admin dashboard at /pentest/fuser renders real data; user dashboard shows ₦750 welcome bonus; /invest shows the 3 seeded plans (Agro Starter, Real Estate Growth, Gold Reserve).

issues: Platform profit shows ₦-750.00 because the welcome bonus paid to the seeded test user is booked as a platform loss on an empty DB. Cosmetic only, not a bug from this fix.

action_items: Route naming mismatch in the bug report: admin login is at /pentest/fuser/login, NOT /admin/login. The path /admin/login just falls through to the regular user /login page. If desired, add a redirect /admin/login -> /pentest/fuser/login in App.js so support docs match reality.
critical_code_review_comments: MONGO_URL fix is correct — backend/.env now uses mongodb://localhost:27017 and DB_NAME=evoque_nova, and startup seed for admin + 3 products + settings works.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with credentials-carrying JWT headers is fine (bearer auth, no cookies), but if cookies ever get added, this will break — worth noting for future.

rca of the issue: Prior Atlas SRV DNS was NXDOMAIN causing FastAPI startup crash -> ingress returned 502/524. Switching MONGO_URL to the container-local mongod resolved it; startup seed populated admin + products. Verified: admin login 0.42s, user login 0.31s, /products 0.09s, /admin/stats 0.09s over the public preview URL.
